root_cause_label: Dependency Installation Failure and Explicit Constraint Violation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent repeatedly failed to install PyTorch by not using the CPU-only wheel index (causing timeouts), and ultimately submitted a solution that explicitly violated the prohibition against using tl.sum, even commenting that it did not know how to implement the logic without it.
t_err_evidence: Step 3: Agent runs 'pip install torch triton==3.4.0' without specifying '--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu', triggering a download of the full CUDA-enabled PyTorch (530+ MB) that consistently times out in the restricted environment.
t_commit_evidence: Step 15: Agent explicitly abandons testing ('torch installation is impossible due to persistent network timeouts... I cannot test the Triton kernel') and writes code blindly into /app/triton_agent_sol.py, making a passing outcome impossible given the code cannot be verified or corrected.
t_surface_evidence: Step 18: The submitted code contains 'tl.sum' calls and comments explicitly admitting 'I am not sure how to remove this without tl.sum so I will leave it', directly violating the task's prohibition on using tl.sum.
trigger_explanation: The correct approach (used in the oracle) was to install PyTorch from the CPU-only wheel index via '--index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu'. The agent instead attempted to install full CUDA-enabled PyTorch packages (530+ MB) from the default PyPI index across multiple retries (steps 3, 4, 6, 8, 14), all of which timed out. Without a working torch installation, the agent could not run or test its Triton kernel, leading it to submit untested code that violated a core constraint.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3 output shows the download is 530+ MB and stalls; steps 4, 6, 8 repeat the same pip install torch command without the CPU-only flag, all timing out. Step 7 tries an unavailable older version. By step 9 the agent tries wget (not available). These are clear repeated failure signals before t_commit at step 15.
